pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding position volume during high-velocity directional wicks or when floating drawdown exceeds 1.5x ATR.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a validated 3-period Volume-Weighted Average Price (VWAP) cross and an order-book imbalance confirmation before market entry authorization.
profit_harvest_threshold: Instantly initiate trailing lock-in when unrealized profit hits +$12.00 to guarantee a final distribution between $15.00 and $30.00.
